description: Vendor-neutral relational database schema library for Java: XML schema definitions, multi-dialect SQL DDL generation (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, H2), live database installation via Flyway or Liquibase, database reverse-engineering, schema diffing and migration SQL generation, and ER diagram generation.
rules: Pin third-party and schema-* module versions via the schema-bom platform BOM; do not declare version numbers directly in consuming build files.
Generate dialect-specific DDL via SQLGeneratorFactory and SQLGeneratorOptions, not by instantiating dialect generator classes directly.
Install schemas into a live database via a SchemaInstaller implementation (FlywaySchemaInstaller or LiquibaseSchemaInstaller), not by running generated DDL manually.
Schema comparison (schema-diff) produces a ChangeSet model, not SQL directly; generate migration SQL from the reviewed ChangeSet via schema-migration-generator's MigrationGeneratorFactory.
